card.name: The word experts starting a clause
card.fires_on: The word "experts" (or similar subject words like "Those") at the start of a sentence or clause in general web prose, where it introduces what authorities say. Also fires on the end of the word "vernacular".

modes.label: Experts as subject
modes.description: The word experts begins a clause that reports what specialists say or think.
modes.example: But more often that not it has been Intel that has kicked down the door when the<< experts>> said it was locked.
